prog_src = '''def transform(grid):
    grid = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # find the seed (value 2) in the single input row
    row0 = grid[0]
    p = row0.index(2)
    N = len(row0)
    g = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]
    # draw the X of 2s: 45-degree rays from (0, p) to the walls
    for r in range(N):
        for c in (p - r, p + r):
            if 0 <= c < N:
                g[r][c] = 2
    def paint(r, c):
        if 0 <= r < N and 0 <= c < N and g[r][c] != 2:
            g[r][c] = 1
    # left ray emits solid 1-lines descending right from every even
    # anti-diagonal cell k >= 2 (virtual spawns below row 0 included):
    # wave from k starts at (k+1, p-k+1)
    for k in range(2, 4 * N, 2):
        r, c = k + 1, p - k + 1
        while r < N and c < N:
            if c >= 0:
                paint(r, c)
            r += 1
            c += 1
    # right ray emits dashed 1-lines descending left from every even
    # row r0 >= 2 that can reach inside the grid (start col p+r0-1);
    # draw at odd j steps; virtual spawns on the right stay silent
    for r0 in range(2, N, 2):
        if p + r0 >= N:
            continue
        rr, cc = r0 + 1, p + r0 - 1
        j = 0
        while 0 <= cc < N and rr < N:
            if j % 2 == 1:
                paint(rr, cc)
            rr += 1
            cc -= 1
            j += 1
    return g
'''
